title: OpenHands
summary: title: OpenHands tags: coding-agent, open-source, autonomous, enterprise # OpenHands AI agent platform for software development that executes real engineering work — not just code suggestions. Runs autonomous agents that plan, write, and apply changes across codebases, designed for enterprise software development at scale. ## Overview - Developer : OpenHands (open-source community) - Backend Model : Multiple LLM backends supported - Interface : Web platform + CLI - Website : openhands.dev - GitHub : OpenHands/OpenHands - Open Source : Yes - Focus : Enterprise AI-driven development, autonomous agents ## Key Capabilities - Autonomous Planning : Agents plan, write, and apply changes across entire codebases - Real Engineering Work : Goes beyond code suggestion to execute actual development tasks - Enterprise Scale : Designed for team-level adoption in enterprise environments - Open Source Foundation : Community-driven development with transparent codebase ## History - Originally known as OpenHands (forked from SWE-agent research) - Evolved from academic SWE-agent project into a full agent platform - Positioned as an open-source alternative to proprietary coding agents like Codex and Claude Code ## Competitive Positioning | Dimension | OpenHands | Codex | Claude Code | |-----------|-----------|-------|-------------| | Open Source | Yes | Partial (CLI) | Partial (SDK) | | Enterprise Focus | Primary | Secondary | Secondary | | Autonomous Planning | Yes | Yes (Goal Mode) | Yes | | Multi-LLM | Yes | No (OpenAI only) | No (Anthropic only) | ## Related - [[openai-codex]] — OpenAI's coding agent - [[claude-code]] — Anthropic's coding agent - [[github-copilot]] — GitHub's AI assistant - [[aider]] — Open-source pair programming agent - [[swe-bench]] — Evaluation benchmark for code agents
